pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/feature-matrix/batch-review/route.ts:81 When a batch-review module run times out, settleExecution aborts it and the route records it as plain 'error' with the typed reason flattened into a message string, because ModuleReviewStatus has no indeterminate state. A killed MCP-enabled run whose effects are unknown therefore reads as a failure, which is the case indeterminate-closure-on-interruption names.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/feature-matrix/batch-review/route.ts:81 Timeout and kill reasons are encoded in a string under status 'error'. The vocabulary ('pending'|'running'|'completed'|'error'|'skipped', src/types/batch-review.ts:24) has no indeterminate status. Batch state is also held only in memory (route.ts:15), so a restart in the middle of a batch leaves nothing to close.
src/app/api/ability-spec/codegen/route.ts:31 The target identity for the agent's report comes from server-merged static fields, so the governed agent cannot retarget which record it writes.
